note: signal-triggered count read of push 9. Doubled coordinates; unit u = cells with x in {2u, 2u+1}; tr(c, k) = (x + 2k, y, z - 2k). A state 'letters' = capL + for each letter i (hex digit h) the stators and the sites of h moved to unit 4 + i + capR moved to unit 4 + N + the run's extra cells (the still life S6b; never changed). runs[].ops = [generation, cells removed (each must be live)]; runs[].checks = [generation, letters]: the whole state equals the state of those letters. H = side of the oracle's cubic torus. trig = the still life placed for a stretch whose first unit is unit 0.

runs.name: trigger
runs.text: a store holding 3 with the still life at its wall; ONE cell removed 12 units before the wall: the pulse arrives and the store leaves as a block of 8 units of wire C; the left cap swallows it; the wire is plain

runs.name: control
runs.text: the same run without the still life: the pulse is absorbed and the store holds 4

runs.name: loop
runs.text: two stores holding 1 and 3, the still life at the wall of the right one; ONE cell removed between them, 11 units from the right store and 10 from the left one: the right store empties into the left one, which then holds 1 + 4

runs.name: write-then-call
runs.text: the right store starts at 1; three left-going pulses made 12 units to its right add one each (the still life does not notice); then ONE cell removed between the stores calls the count out: the left store holds 1 + 5
